messages:
Lina: Quick sync — ACME trial kickoff. Need to align success criteria, evals, and any security/pricing blockers before Friday.
Sam: Thx. main use case is billing-summary extraction + conversational QA over invoices. Target latency 300ms p50, throughput ~30 req/s.
Tyler: For throughput we'll probably recommend a quantized 8-bit model on Dedicated, batching window ~20ms. :thinking_face:
Matt: Also important: accuracy metric on entity extraction (precision/recall) + hallucination rate threshold for QA. Suggest these gates: precision >= 0.92, recall >= 0.88, hallucination < 3% on golden set.
Anya: Security note — ACME's legal asked for data residency + SOC2 checklist. I'll need the security questionnaire answers by Wed. Can Sales share the comsec contact? @Lina
Lina: CC'ing their SOC lead in the email thread. We'll attach our standard questionnaire and the Dedicated/Private architecture diagram.
Sam: For the eval harness I sketched a minimal config. Please review:

```json
{
  "scoring": {
    "entity_precision_weight": 0.6,
    "entity_recall_weight": 0.3,
    "hallucination_penalty": 0.1,
    "pass_threshold": 0.85
  },
  "regression_gate": "strict",
  "golden_sample_count": 150
}
```

Tyler: LGTM. Recommend adding a per-prompt timeout (2s) and a prefix caching test for common invoice headers.
Matt: We should include a few adversarial prompts in the golden set that are easy hallucination traps (ambiguous dates, merged line-items). Put 20 of those in the seed.
Lina: Timeline check — we need a runnable harness + seed golden set by Tue (2 days). Can engineering deliver that?
EngBot: build-harness job scheduled. ETA 36 hours for baseline runner + metrics export to S3.
Tyler: I can put together the prompt templates today. Example anchor prompt:

"Extract invoice_id, total, currency, and line_items from the text. Return JSON only. If field missing, return null."

And one golden sample:

"Invoice: 4721\nDate: 2025-11-03\nItems: 3 x Bolt (USD 12.00), 1 x Service (USD 120.00)\nTotal: USD 156.00"

Expected JSON: {"invoice_id":"4721","total":"156.00","currency":"USD",...}

Anya: For the security questionnaire, ACME will require encryption-at-rest proof and KMS integration details. Tyler/Matt — include key rotation and HSM notes in the doc.
FinanceOps: Pricing question — they asked about burst pricing for dedicated pools. Lina, can you confirm expected commit level? Also share a rough MRR estimate to plug into the quote.
Lina: We asked for traffic profile; defaulting to 4x baseline for burst. I'll share the profile by EOD. Rough initial commit looks like 2 dedicated GPUs for 3 months.
Sam: Operationally, we should add an A/B rollback plan in case of quality regressions. Suggest: canary 10% traffic, monitor precision/latency for 24h, auto-roll back if pass_rate < 0.8 or latency > 500ms.
Matt: Agreed. Add a regression gate with nightly evals against the golden set; if any metric drops >5% vs baseline, trigger alert and pause rollouts.
Lina: Sounds good. Action items: Tyler — seed prompts + adversarial set (today). Sam — harness config + canary policy (tomorrow). Anya — questionnaire answers + diagrams (Wed). FinanceOps — draft pricing tiers based on 2 GPU commit (EOD). Matt — add nightly regression job to runner (tomorrow).
Tyler: I'll push the prompt CSV to S3 under s3://redwood-trials/acme/goldenset.csv when done.
EngBot: uploader job succeeded (s3://redwood-trials/acme/goldenset.csv) — 175 records.
Lina: :thumbsup: Excellent. If anything blocks, ping in this thread and I'll escalate with ACME.
Sam: One more thought — include a small human-eval bucket (10 samples) for ambiguous cases to validate human judgement vs automated scorer.
Matt: Good call. We'll surface that in the trial report dashboard.
Anya: Also locking down IP and data use terms in SOW. Lina, include that in the contract draft.
Lina: Will do. Closing the loop — next sync Friday 10am to review harness results and pricing. Thanks team.
